owner_confirmation.note: Owner manually exercised phone-side capture on the emulator after the automated run and confirmed it works. Exact steps (copy -> notification -> tap -> saved; sensitive skip toast) were not itemized; the automated rows above carry the device-log evidence for those paths.

not_tested_on_device: Toggle-off behavior (block disabled): covered by the unit test sensitiveBlock_allowsWhenDisabled; the app-private pref cannot be flipped from adb without root.

Notification tap through the shade: adb shade interaction was flaky this session (one tap landed on nothing and produced no trampoline start). The notification-tap -> trampoline -> save path was proven end-to-end on 2026-09-29 (results_emulator_accessibility.json), and the trampoline mode launches the identical activity with the same launch semantics.
emulator_artifacts: Host-clipboard write-back can revert a guest clipboard write minutes later; a drain run that spanned that window observed Skipped(reason=duplicate) on the reverted value. Reads within seconds of the write are reliable and are what the pass rows above use.
Clipboard change events can fire 2-3 times for a single write (guest->host->guest sync). Harmless: the identical clip signature dedups.
cleanup: App data cleared (pm clear) after the run; POST_NOTIFICATIONS re-granted. The vault contained only probe strings from this session; prior real content was cleared on 2026-09-30 with owner approval.
